title: alloispermum integrifolium
intro: Alloispermum integrifolium, commonly known as the "Wild Celery" or "Makalani", is a plant species native to the Pacific Islands. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, Alloispermum integrifolium is used for its actions as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
